name: UAA Cross Country Championships
where: Warrenville, IL · host Chicago · St. James Farm
headline: UAA Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: NYU swept the team titles. The NYU women won with 28 points over Chicago (50), WashU (97) and Carnegie Mellon (106), and NYU’s Josephine Dziedzic won the 6K in 20:36.5. The NYU men edged Carnegie Mellon 58-61, with Chicago third (69) and WashU fourth (76); WashU’s Max Sudrzynski won the 8K in 24:17.7.
